title: Nice Spicy Mexican Fish Tacos
description: A pescatarian friendly Mexican dish featuring panang paste and sauteed fish, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This kid friendly recipe is a twist on traditional tacos with a floral and shattering crunch from the poblano peppers.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced poblano peppers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the panang paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cod fillets and cook until opaque and flaky, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Season the fish with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a piece of the fish onto a tortilla and topping with onion, poblano peppers, and cilantro.
Drizzle the lime juice over the top of the tacos and serve immediately.
